purpose: Candidate automated-draft cross-references for source/legal review, not extraction lineage or semantic-equivalence proof.

methodology.draft_origin: Existing actual automated extraction cache artifacts only; no model calls were made to create this mapping.
methodology.final_rule_origin: Agent-assisted source audit; an overlapping draft is not asserted to be the origin of a final rule.
methodology.inclusion: Exact source ID and category; matching source URL/current text hash; both quotes occur verbatim in that capture; continuous source-position overlap containing at least 20 non-whitespace characters.
methodology.offsets: Zero-based UTF-16 string offsets matching the application evaluator; end offset is exclusive.
limitations: Quote overlap does not establish that summaries, effective dates, exemptions, predicates, or interactions mean the same thing.
No candidate cross-reference proves extraction lineage.
No rule in this file is asserted to have human legal review.
Absence of a matching draft quote does not mean absence of source evidence or absence of law.

candidate_draft_cross_references.match_basis: Exact source ID, source URL, current captured-text hash, category, and continuous quote overlap containing at least 20 non-whitespace characters.
